name: ptee-dns-egress
title: Don't forget DNS: the one egress every pod needs
summary: A cluster-wide default-deny silently breaks name resolution, and an app that can't resolve a hostname looks 'randomly broken'. Carve out egress to CoreDNS on port 53 (UDP and TCP) for every workload, while leaving the system namespaces - including CoreDNS itself - out of the lockdown.
